description:
Get reported market-cap history. Returns an asset's reported market capitalisation in USD over a
configurable lookback window, sampled at a configurable resolution.

Each point is the figure the data provider reported at that timestamp.
The snapshot is written on the provider's ingest cadence, which is
coarser than a minute, so a `resolution` of at least `1h` is what the
series can actually fill. Buckets with no snapshot behind them are
absent rather than zero.

See the [Time Window & Resolution](#section/Time-Window-and-Resolution)
section for the format of `window` and `resolution`.

resolution.description: Bucket size (e.g. `5m`, `1h`, `1d`). Must be at least `1h` for windows over `1d`.

symbol.description: Asset symbol to fetch market cap for (e.g. `SOL`, `BTC`).

name: get_market_cap_history
